svg.aria-label: About. I build AI agents, and the systems that put them to work. I'm a software engineer in Lahore. Most of my work is AI agents that talk to customers for real businesses: voice agents that answer the phone, assistants that reply on websites and by text, and the automation that turns each conversation into an order, a request or a task for the team. I also build the operations software those businesses run on, and my own tools, like Sulehri, an AI tutor for the Mac. What I care about is simple: systems that work in production, every day. Voice agents: Answer phone calls, take orders and requests, and hand off to a person when needed. Chat and text assistants: Reply on websites and by text, collect the details, and alert the team. Customer automation: Summaries, follow-up texts, emails and records after every conversation. Operations software: Dispatch, delivery and admin tools that a business runs on daily.
